mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (based on 2015-07-15 data window).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) signals weak labor market and economic distress, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST) and fall in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a supply-side disruption in the housing sector that increases economic uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST MoM > 0.5% and INDPRO MoM < 0.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation environment (CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.5%), a federal funds rate increase above 0.25% signals premature monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.5% and FEDFUNDS > 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS MoM > 0.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below zero MoM signals weak consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS MoM < 0.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) supports consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST MoM > 0.0%.
